- Ask AI takes several selected messages and the photos and files of the messages: up to 10 in all, each up to 30 MB. Pictures sent as files count as photos; documents (txt, md, csv, json, pdf, doc/docx, xls/xlsx, ppt/pptx, odt and others) are taken, archives, video, stickers and voice are not. The box says what was left out and why. A site uploads attachments to its servers as soon as they are added, before you press Send.
- The Ask AI warning is shown only the first time; the box has no permanent note.
- Settings > MZGram > AI: a button in the main menu for each AI site, which opens it without a message. Off by default.
- Settings > MZGram > Interface: switches that hide Telegram Premium, My Stars, Gram Earnings, Telegram Business, Premium Gifting, Telegram FAQ, Telegram Features and Ask a Question in Telegram's Settings and its search.
- Settings > MZGram lists its topics as on Android; the new Other topic holds Check for updates and, on Windows, Unblock MZGram files. The note under the topics is gone.
- Message menu: Copy Photo, Delete Downloaded File and Forward without sender, as on Android. The MZGram items are in the menu of a message in the main chat too.
- MZGram language: Same as Telegram is the new default, so MZGram's texts follow Telegram Desktop's language. A language chosen before is kept.
- Windows: Settings > MZGram > Other > Unblock MZGram files removes the "downloaded from the internet" mark from MZGram's files, only when you press it and after a warning. Windows protection stays on.
